description: Adds BYD navigation-audio routing for the inspected Google Maps 26.32.06.958047303 and 26.33.02.961351034 APKs while preserving the original Google Maps voice-search behavior and audio focus. On supported BYD builds, Maps MediaAlert playback uses the vendor navigation stream 14 AudioAttributes mapping before native track creation; non-BYD and unsupported devices retain the original audio behavior. Retains ReVanced GmsCore compatibility, package and permission rewrites, notification suppression, Timeline routing, and the original Picture-in-Picture declaration.
